title: On the Origin of Qur’anic Arabic
description: Argues, on al-Jallad's epigraphic data, that Qur'anic Arabic developed directly from Nabataean Arabic — resolving the failure to find a matching Hijazi dialect and the rarity of the al- article in pre-Islamic inscriptions.

cited_by.title: The First Mosques Faced Petra, Not Mecca
